taṇhādhipateyya.p: [Taṇhādhipati+ṇeyya] (ti) CL=7 It is come from that chief which is craving,  It has a chief which is craving, it is the follower of craving.
a: တဏှာဓိပတေယျ(တိ)
[တဏှာဓိပတိ+ဏေယျ]
